links.outcome: Effect of adding an 'unknown' option (with or without penalty) on LLM accuracy and hallucination
links.effect: Prompts with an 'unknown' option, alone or combined with a penalty for incorrect answers, did not improve model accuracy on the Chinese Dental Licensing Examination.
links.quote: Prompts that included an ‘unknown’ option—or combined it with a penalty for incorrect answers—did not improve model accuracy.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance on Chinese Dental Licensing Exams and specifically tests a prompt-level guardrail (introducing an 'unknown' option with/without penalties to mitigate hallucinations and improve accuracy).

primary.practice: prompting with unknown option and penalty for incorrect answers
